lines: Devinjit Singh, Investor Selling Shareholder, has up to ₹0.91 crore in proceeds from up to 6,750 shares in the offer for sale.
The money has been in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago), and the trigger was shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago.
Retained value is an estimate of ₹2.13 crore at offer price; the gain is up to ₹0.67 crore before offer expenses and taxes.
Confidence is medium: name verified in the seller table, holdings found in one section only (promoter_holding).
